# Pull request

## 1. Change

<!-- State observable before/after behavior and scope. Link the stacked parent and name the comparison base/head. -->

## 2. Review focus

<!-- Name material decisions, compatibility changes, required release actions, and remaining risks. Give accepted follow-ups an owner and revisit trigger. -->

## 3. Verification

<!-- Record tested commits, check results, independent review scope/findings/dispositions, and correction verification. Identify any reviewed uncommitted snapshot. Link accessible evidence. -->

## 4. Live acceptance

<!-- Give workflow, source commit, image digest, API/worker revisions, and health result. Record the author's scenarios, expected/observed results, and personal confirmation. Automated evidence does not supply personal acceptance. -->
<!-- If runtime/image/deployment/migration behavior is unchanged, state Not applicable with a reason under CONTRIBUTING.md. Otherwise identify deferred proof and link any owner-accepted exception. Bootstrap health is not full live acceptance. -->

## 5. Checklist

<!-- Leave personal testing unchecked until the author confirms it. Replace exempt live items with Not applicable and the reason; replace accepted-exception items with their supporting link. -->

- [ ] All required checks pass for this candidate.
- [ ] Independent review is complete and accepted findings are fixed and verified.
- [ ] I deployed this candidate to staging.
- [ ] I personally tested the relevant staging flows and confirmed expected results.
- [ ] Documentation is synchronized with the change.
